title: Photoluminescence for Defect Detection on Full-Sized Photovoltaic Modules
mechanism: Outdoor PL on full modules, with the same defects compared across PL, IR, EL and UVF.
adaptation: Physics reference for WattCycle deployment and the benchmark's modality notes: thin cracks need EL; thermal or PL alone will not replace EL for crack segmentation.
evidence: R: 5 of 7 defect types detected well in PL; cracks only under certain conditions; interconnection failures not at all.
prior_overlap: Agrees with the BRIEF thermal desk study; nothing new to test.
